title: India installed renewable energy capacity, excluding large hydro
unit: GW (cumulative, end of fiscal year unless noted)

source.title: Installed Renewable Energy Capacity (MW) (Excluding Large Hydro Power) - year-wise achievement

note: All points except Dec 2022 are derived by summing MNRE's cumulative-till-31.03.2014 figure (35,849.59 MW) and its annual additions (total row) as displayed on the MNRE year-wise page on 2026-10-17; rounded to 2 decimals. Dec 2022 (120.90 GW = solar 63.30 + wind 41.93 + bio 10.73 + small hydro 4.94) is from a Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha answer of Feb 2023 as reported, and the Standing Committee on Energy. Definition matches the 175 GW target (solar, wind, biomass, small hydro; large hydro excluded). MNRE's 2025-26 total row looked anomalous on the page, so the series stops at Mar 2025.
